records.text: Newer cars can be shut down remotely while they are being driven.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: They already can shut down a large portion of cars automatically, the newer ones. They can just literally while you're driving shut that down.

verification.notes: GM documents that eligible connected vehicles can be remotely slowed while running through OnStar Stolen Vehicle Slowdown and that certain 2025-or-later fleet vehicles can have drive disabled remotely. The capability is conditional and not universal to all newer cars.

sources.title: GM OnStar Stolen Vehicle Assistance
sources.relevance: Official GM documentation confirms remote slowdown of a running stolen vehicle and remote ignition blocking on eligible vehicles.

records.text: High-resolution video surveillance is built into every street corner and is how many crimes are solved.
records.speaker: Kevin O'Leary

appearances.snippet: I would say now with the amount of high resolution video and surveillance that is built into every street corner. ... That's how they solve a lot of crimes.

verification.notes: Video surveillance is widespread and often assists investigations, but the universal claim that high-resolution surveillance is built into every street corner has no defined jurisdiction and no authoritative nationwide evidence. No-result research is not a basis for marking it false.
